title: Edit a macro as text
summary: Paste register `a`, fix a typo, yank it back.

frames.caption: {key:"}{key:a}{key:p} pastes the macro as editable text.
frames.narration: Macros are register contents. Fix the keystrokes on the line, then {key:"}{key:a}{key:y}{key:y} to put the corrected sequence back.

frames.caption: Change `!` to `x`, yank back into `a`.
frames.narration: Next {key:@}{key:a} plays the edited version — no re-recording required.
